help: usage: fleet-switchboard send [-h] [--file FILE] [--issue ISSUE] [--interrupt] [--from SENDER] name [text ...] positional arguments: name The recipient's fleet name text The message (at most 4000 characters; a longer one goes with --file) options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --file FILE Read the message from this file (a regular file of at most 100000 characters); a long one is sent as numbered parts "part 2 of 3" --issue ISSUE The issue the message is about --interrupt Stop and hold orders only: abort the recipient's running turn (its in-flight tool call is cut), then deliver the message as a wake. Only a boss to its own worker. --from SENDER Lab only: the sender's fleet name
